checks.text: The page displays the heading "Quick Notes" and, with no notes saved, shows the text "No notes yet".

Typing "Meeting" in the field labelled "Title" and "Discuss Q3 roadmap" in the field labelled "Content", then clicking the button "Save note", adds a list item containing "Meeting" and "Discuss Q3 roadmap"; the text "No notes yet" is removed.

Typing "Grocery list" in the field labelled "Title" and "Milk, eggs, bread" in the field labelled "Content", then clicking "Save note", adds a second list item containing "Grocery list" and "Milk, eggs, bread".
Typing "Meet" in the field labelled "Search" filters the list to show only the item containing "Meeting"; the item containing "Grocery list" is not visible.
Clicking the button "Delete Meeting" removes the item containing "Meeting" from the list; the item containing "Grocery list" remains visible.
Clicking the button "Export JSON" triggers a file download named "quick-notes.json" whose content includes the string "Grocery list".
Clicking the tab labelled "All" shows both notes; clicking the tab labelled "Archived" shows the text "No notes yet" because no notes are archived.
Typing "Milk" in the field labelled "Search" and pressing the Enter key shows only the item containing "Grocery list" in the results list.
Reload keeps the note titled "Grocery list" with content "Milk, eggs, bread" visible in the list.
